title: Genie One is now available in Google Sheets
body: You can now use [Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one) directly in the *Databricks Connector for Google Sheets*. Query your governed Databricks data in natural language and import the results into Google Sheets as native rows and columns. See [Use Genie in Google Sheets](/aws/en/integrations/google-sheets/genie).
